meta.name: harden
meta.description: Improve interface resilience through better error handling, i18n support, text overflow handling, and edge case management. Makes interfaces robust and production-ready.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 增强界面鲁棒性，处理边界情况和错误
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在开发前端界面，希望提升其稳定性和生产就绪度
copy.tagline_en: Improve interface resilience by handling errors and edge cases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop frontend interfaces and want to make them robust and production-ready

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你检查并改进界面代码，处理超长文本、错误状态、国际化、空数据等边缘情况，让界面更健壮。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 加固某个界面或组件，或讨论如何提升界面鲁棒性时触发。

say.text: 帮我加固这个用户列表组件。
say.note: Claude 会分析并给出改进建议。

say.text: 这个按钮在德语下会溢出，怎么修复？
say.note: Claude 会提供 CSS 或布局方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you review and improve interface code to handle edge cases like long text, errors, internationalization, empty states, and more, making the UI more robust.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to harden a specific interface or component, or when discussing how to improve interface resilience.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest improvements.

say_en.text: This button overflows in German, how to fix?
say_en.note: Claude will provide CSS or layout solutions.
